newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire Group tumbles on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire Group tumbles on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire Group Plc tumbled on Friday after the company warned that the continuing strength of sterling made it increasingly difficult to preserve margins, particularly in its main European markets.
Shares in the maker of dyes and specialist chemicals were marked down 32-1/2p or 13 percent at 210 by 1238 GMT, in thin trade of 7,700 shares.

The company said 50 percent of its currency exposure was covered by forward exchange contracts, but warned that the continuation of sterling's current strength "will inevitably have an adverse effect on profits this year."
The sharp decline in the stock reversed a rally propelled by better-than-expected year-end results reported on March 17.
